# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, using GitHub private vulnerability
reporting:

<https://github.com/BearingQuest/bearingquest.github.io/security/advisories/new>

Please don't open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability.

This is a personal project run by one person. I read every report, but I can't
promise a response time.

## Supported version

Only the live site, built from `main`, is supported. There are no releases and
no older versions to patch.

## Scope

In scope:

- The files published to bearingquest.com (the paths in `site-files.txt`).
- The workflows and other configuration in this repository.

Out of scope:

- GitHub Pages itself. Report problems there to GitHub.
- Cloudflare itself. Report problems there to Cloudflare.
